item.title: Shadows of the Dungeon - Kickstarter live
item.description: The Kickstarter campaign for Shadows of the Dungeon has started: Shadows of the Dungeon - Kickstarter Trailer (5.5e Dungeon Crawler RPG) Shadows of the Dungeon is a first-person dungeon crawler built on the 5.5e rules (SRD 5.2.1). You lead a party of four to six prisoners through the depths of Torment Keep, fight in real time with pause, and switch between grid steps and free movement whenever you like....

item.title: One Fenix Down - Release Day
item.description: The party-based RPG One Fenix Down will be released today: ONE FENIX DOWN - Release Trailer A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption....

item.title: Dreadmoor - Early Access Release
item.description: The adventure RPG Dreadmore will be released into Early Access today: Dreadmore Dreadmore is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land....
